build_tree_agent_pipeline: build a TreeAgentPipeline to chain speech-to-speech and speech-to-text agents in a directed acyclic graph
create_instantiated_pipeline: create an InstantiatedTreeAgentPipeline with EnglishSpeechToSpeech, EnglishWait2SpeechToSpeech, and EnglishWait2SpeechToText modules
test_tree_pipeline_from_args: test the TreeAgentPipeline by instantiating agents from command-line arguments via from_args
refactor_pipeline_with_dot_agent: refactor the pipeline by swapping EnglishWait2SpeechToText with DotSpeechToText for dot-based output
review_wait2_agent: review the EnglishWait2SpeechToText and EnglishWait2SpeechToSpeech agents that set a 2-second wait policy
